newsitem.title: USA: PaineWebber fires banking analyst - report.
newsitem.headline: PaineWebber fires banking analyst - report.

text.p: PaineWebber Group Inc has fired banking analyst Lawrence Cohn, according to a report in Wednesday's American Banker.
The report quoted Cohn as saying he was fired. The analyst could not be reached for comment.
A spokesman for PaineWebber was not immediately available for comment.
American Banker said Ruchi Madan, who was the banking analyst at Prudential Securities, has joined PaineWebber.
The publication said Cohn's views on the the banking industry have been less bullish than those of other analysts.
